title: Create src/cli.ts and wire Commander.js program
description: Create the main CLI program file using Commander.js. Instantiate a program with the correct name, description, and version (read dynamically from package.json). Export the program for use by bin/rocket.ts.
acceptanceCriteria: Commander program is instantiated with name 'rocket'
Program description is 'AI-powered project scaffolding and development loop'
Program version is read dynamically from package.json
Program is exported as a named export
rocket --version prints the version from package.json

steps.details: Create src/cli.ts. Import Command from commander: `import { Command } from 'commander'`. Also import createRequire to read package.json: `import { createRequire } from 'module'`.
Use createRequire to load package.json: `const require = createRequire(import.meta.url); const pkg = require('../package.json')`. This works in ESM context to read the package version dynamically.
Create the program: `export const program = new Command(); program.name('rocket').description('AI-powered project scaffolding and development loop').version(pkg.version)`
Run `npm run dev -- --help` and `npm run dev -- --version`. Help should show 'rocket' as the command name. Version should match the version in package.json (0.1.0).

technicalNotes: In ESM modules, __dirname and require() are not available — use createRequire(import.meta.url) to load JSON files
Alternatively, use `import pkg from '../package.json' assert { type: 'json' }` with TypeScript resolveJsonModule enabled
